description: Configured device cards with spec checklists, warranty note, quote + checkout CTAs.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { CheckIcon, MinusIcon, PlusIcon, ShieldCheckIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import amexImg from "./images/amex.webp" import laptop1Img from "./images/laptop-1.webp" import laptop2Img from "./images/laptop-2.webp" import mastercardImg from "./images/mastercard.webp" import visaImg from "./images/visa.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const SHIPPING = 4 const TAX = 4 type CartItem = { id: number name: string image: string alt: string price: number quantity: number specs: string[] } const INITIAL_ITEMS: CartItem[] = [ { id: 1, name: "HP ProBook 455 (15.6) 39.6 cm G9 Business Laptop", image: assetSrc(laptop1Img), alt: "HP ProBook", price: 1020, quantity: 1, specs: [ "AMD Ryzen™ 5 processor", "FreeDOS", "16 GB DDR4 RAM", "512 GB PCIe® NVMe™ SSD", ], }, { id: 2, name: "ThinkPad E16 40.64cms — 13th Gen Intel i5", image: assetSrc(laptop2Img), alt: "ThinkPad E16", price: 1100, quantity: 1, specs: [ "13th Gen Intel® Core™ i5", "FreeDOS", "16 GB DDR4 RAM", "512 GB PCIe® NVMe™ SSD", ], }, ] const PAYMENT_LOGOS = [ { src: assetSrc(mastercardImg), alt: "Mastercard" }, { src: assetSrc(visaImg), alt: "Visa" }, { src: assetSrc(amexImg), alt: "American Express" }, ] as const export default function ShoppingCart({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { const [cartItems, setCartItems] = React.useState(INITIAL_ITEMS) const subtotal = cartItems.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.quantity, 0) const total = subtotal + SHIPPING + TAX return (

Business devices

Configured cart

{cartItems.length} systems

    {cartItems.map((item) => (

  • {item.name}

    ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}

      {item.specs.map((spec) => (
    • {spec}
      • ))}
    Qty
    {item.quantity}
    1-year business warranty
    • ))}

Quote summary

  • Subtotal ${subtotal.toFixed(2)}
  • Shipping ${SHIPPING.toFixed(2)}
  • Tax ${TAX.toFixed(2)}
  • Total ${total.toFixed(2)}
{PAYMENT_LOGOS.map((logo) => ( ))}
) }
